mapper.sql: IPMAP_NO, SSYS_ID, SNAME, SFULL_NAME, SPROM_YN, ILEVEL, IREF, SDISP_YN, ISEQ, SINS_DT, IPROM_NO
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE mt AS ( SELECT IPMAP_NO, SSYS_ID, SNAME, SFULL_NAME, SPROM_YN, ILEVEL, IREF, SDISP_YN, ISEQ, SINS_DT, IPROM_NO, CAST(CONCAT(SPROM_YN, LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(ISEQ,999999) AS text), 6, '0'), LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(IPROM_NO,0) AS text), 10, '0')) AS TEXT) AS SPATH FROM TB_PROM_MAP WHERE IREF = 0 AND SDISP_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT c.IPMAP_NO, c.SSYS_ID, c.SNAME, c.SFULL_NAME, c.SPROM_YN, c.ILEVEL, c.IREF, c.SDISP_YN, c.ISEQ, c.SINS_DT, c.IPROM_NO, CONCAT(mt.SPATH, '/', c.SPROM_YN, LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(c.ISEQ,999999) AS text), 6, '0'), LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(c.IPROM_NO,0) AS text), 10, '0')) FROM TB_PROM_MAP c JOIN mt ON c.IREF = mt.IPMAP_NO WHERE c.SDISP_YN = 'Y' ) SELECT IPMAP_NO, SSYS_ID, SNAME, SFULL_NAME, SPROM_YN, ILEVEL, IREF, SDISP_YN, ISEQ, SINS_DT, IPROM_NO, CASE WHEN SPROM_YN = 'Y' AND ( SELECT MAX(cur.SSTART_DT) FROM TB_PROM snap, TB_PROM cur WHERE snap.IPROM_NO = mt.IPROM_NO AND cur.ILAW_ID = snap.ILAW_ID AND cur.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' ) > TO_CHAR(LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PENDING_YN FROM mt ORDER BY SPATH
SELECT FROM TB_PROM_MAP WHERE IREF = #{ref} AND SDISP_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SPROM_YN, ISEQ, IPROM_NO
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ISEQ), 0) + 1 FROM TB_PROM_MAP WHERE IREF = #{ref} AND SDISP_YN = 'Y'
mapper.sql: ( SELECT rk.ILAW_ID, rk.ICATE_NO CUR_CATE, rk.SGUBUN_ID CUR_GUBUN FROM ( SELECT pl.ILAW_ID, pl.ICATE_NO, pl.SGUBUN_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pl.ILAW_ID ORDER BY pl.ILAW_NO DESC, pl.IPROM_NO DESC) RNK FROM TB_PROM pl ) rk WHERE rk.RNK = 1 )
mapper.select:
SELECT PR.IPROM_NO, PR.STITLE, PR.SPROM_DT, CA.SFULL_NAME, PR.SSYS_ID, CASE WHEN PR.SSTART_DT > TO_CHAR(LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PENDING_YN FROM TB_PROM PR, TB_CATE CA WHERE PR.ILAW_ID IN ( SELECT ILAW_ID FROM TB_PROM WHERE IPROM_NO IN ( SELECT IPROM_NO FROM TB_PROM_MAP WHERE IREF = #{ref} AND SPROM_YN = 'Y' ) ) AND PR.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y'
AND ( PR.SNULL_DT IS NULL OR TRIM(PR.SNULL_DT) = '' OR PR.SNULL_DT = '--' OR PR.SNULL_DT >= TO_CHAR(LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) AND PR.ICATE_NO = CA.ICATE_NO
AND PR.ILAW_ID NOT IN ( SELECT lcd.ILAW_ID FROM lcd WHERE lcd.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT dtd.ICATE_NO FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE crd AS ( SELECT dd.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE dd WHERE dd.SDEL_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT ch.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ch JOIN crd ON ch.IREF = crd.ICATE_NO ) SELECT ICATE_NO FROM crd ) dtd ) )
AND ( PR.ILAW_ID NOT IN ( SELECT lcr.ILAW_ID FROM lcr WHERE lcr.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT rr.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER rr UNION SELECT dt1.ICATE_NO FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE cr1 AS ( SELECT ca.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ca WHERE ca.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT r.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER r WHERE r.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' ) UNION ALL SELECT ch.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ch JOIN cr1 ON ch.IREF = cr1.ICATE_NO ) SELECT ICATE_NO FROM cr1 ) dt1 ) OR lcr.CUR_GUBUN IN ( SELECT gg.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_GUBUN_READER gg ) ) OR PR.ILAW_ID IN ( SELECT lca.ILAW_ID FROM lca WHERE lca.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT rm.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER rm WHERE ( ( rm.READER_TY = 'USER' AND rm.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( rm.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND rm.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) UNION SELECT dt2.ICATE_NO FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE cr2 AS ( SELECT cm.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE cm WHERE cm.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT r2.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER r2 WHERE r2.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' AND ( ( r2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND r2.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( r2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND r2.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) ) UNION ALL SELECT ch.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ch JOIN cr2 ON ch.IREF = cr2.ICATE_NO ) SELECT ICATE_NO FROM cr2 ) dt2 ) OR lca.CUR_GUBUN IN ( SELECT g2.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_GUBUN_READER g2 WHERE ( ( g2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND g2.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( g2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND g2.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) ) ) )
ORDER BY PR.IPROM_NO
SELECT IPROM_NO AS "promNo", STITLE AS "title" FROM TB_PROM WHERE ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} AND SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY COALESCE(ISEQ, 9999), IPROM_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PROM_MAP SET SNAME = #{name} WHERE IPMAP_NO = #{pmapNo}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PROM_MAP WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} AND SPROM_YN = 'Y'
